stem_book: Two blocks 'A' and 'B' of mass 'm' and '4m' are connected with a rod PQ of length 'l' and mass 6m through light strings. There is no friction anywhere. End P of the rod slides on the incline (its string runs up along the incline over a pulley to A) and end Q slides on the horizontal floor (its string runs horizontally over a pulley to B). If the system is released from rest and the rod PQ slides on the incline, then for the position shown in the figure (β = angle between rod and incline at P, α = angle between rod and floor at Q), the ratio of the speeds of the mass 'A' to that of the mass 'B' is (a) sinα/sinβ (b) cosα/cosβ (c) cos(α+β)/cos(α−β) (d) sin(α+β)/sin(α−β)
work: Rigid rod: v_P cosβ = v_Q cosα, v_A = v_P, v_B = v_Q → v_A/v_B = cosα/cosβ
